name: HORNBACH Holding (HBH)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. The shares trade about 8% below the Base value of €91.04, which is not enough: net debt is measured at the seasonal low, cash flow after lease payments is thin, and a 30% margin of safety puts the buy zone at €63.73 or below.
llms: European DIY retailer (177 stores in nine countries, about 62% of retail space owned, sales per square meter lead the German sector) listed on Xetra. Sales rose 6.0% to EUR 3.8 billion in the six months to August 2026, but net debt is seasonally low at the half year and cash flow after lease payments is thin. Bear EUR 70.12, Base EUR 91.04, Bull EUR 112.86. Verdict Hold at EUR 83.70, maximum buy price EUR 63.73.
